title: Adding money
summary: A box, a button, and a “total” variable that grows.
done: You know how the piggy bank adds what you type.

hello.text: Here is **My piggy bank**! Type a number in the preview and tap “+ Add”.

add.text: When “Add” is tapped, the **total** variable grows by what is typed.

number.text: What you type is a **text**. “× 1” turns it into a **number**: else 2 + 3 would make “23”!

show.text: The function writes the total followed by “€”.

slow.text: Start **slow motion** to see the blocks light up.

watch.text: Add money in the preview: [change total by …] lights up.
watch.hint: Type a number in the preview, then tap “+ Add”.

toast.text: Show a short message when you add money.
toast.hint: The block is in the Interface category.

ten.text: Add a “+10 €” button that adds 10 to the total.
ten.hint: Put a button in Design, then [when … is clicked] with [change total by 10].
